text:
rachel: FYI saw a short, sharp NVMe IOPS choke in eu-north1-cohort4 at ~07:12 UTC. GPU attach ops failed intermittently; attach success dropped ~28% for ~6m.

noah: any raw metrics or logs? which pool?

rachel: pool cohort4-ephemeral. iostat snapshot from one host: ```iostat -x 1 2
Device:         r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await r_await w_await  %util
nvme0n1        0.00  460.00    0.00 11520.00   50.00    7.20 16.1   0.0    16.1   99.8
```

eva: avgqu + util look pegged. timeline? any janitor/snapshot overlap?

rachel: yes  janitor accepted a backlog of verify jobs from controller at 07:10, then the scheduler returned intermittent 429s. when the rate-limit window slid, a wave of scrubs and a volume-resize job kicked at once. also saw storage control-plane retries during that window. storage-ci-bot: "rpc_retries: spike 07:10-07:14 count=412"

noah: mixed events: scrub backlog + resize + control-plane jitter = IO amplification. quick containment ideas: 1) apply per-cohort scrub backoff, 2) reduce scrub concurrency, 3) pause noncritical resizes and snapshots, 4) increase gpu attach timeout to avoid immediate fallback. preferences?

eva: prefer 1+2+4 short-term. resizes can be retried; pausing them avoids extra tinywrites. also throttle controller scheduling hysteresis so it doesn't hand out many jobs at once after a 429 window.

rachel: applying now: ops-bot: `scheduler set-backoff --cohort cohort4-ephemeral --duration 900s` and `janitor set-concurrency --cohort cohort4-ephemeral --concurrency 1`. also paused noncritical-resizes: `volume-resizer pause --cohort cohort4-ephemeral --tag noncritical --duration 1200s`.

ops-bot: "actions accepted: backoff applied, janitor concurrency set to 1, resizes paused (canary)"

noah: bumping attach timeout in autoscaler canary from 30s -> 90s to reduce fallback churn. rolling to eu-north1 canary now.

rachel: monitoring queries to watch: `sum(rate(nvme_io_time_seconds_total[2m])) by (cohort)`, `avg(nvme_avg_queue_size{cohort="cohort4-ephemeral"})`, and `increase(gpu_attach_failed_total[5m])`.

eva: noted. early effect: avgqu dropped from ~7.6 -> ~1.8 within ~5m and attach failures normalized. control-plane RPC retries also fell after the backoff.

noah: any hint of firmware or thermal issues on hosts?

rachel: checked S.M.A.R.T / dmesg. no CRC flood, but a few hosts show elevated temp sensors coincident with the wave. likely transient due to IO. logged host ids for follow-up.

eva: follow-ups: 1) implement scheduler hysteresis so a 429 window doesn't release a bulk of jobs at once, 2) make scrub jobs taggable by priority so we migrate only checksum-fix jobs under backlog, 3) add a small cooldown on volume-resizer so resizes don't run during scrub-heavy windows, 4) run a control-plane stress test to reproduce rpc-retry amplification.

noah: cost note: fallback and canary fallback during the 6m window estimated +$640. logging to incident-costs and tagging infra-storage.

rachel: unpausing resizes after 25m with coordinated staggered windows and leaving scrub concurrency low for 30m. will open a short retro ticket if this pattern recurs. :white_check_mark:
